summary: Test-only change: three new files matching the spec's names and test titles, with no src/ changes (git diff 1fe8095 -- src is empty) and no edits to locked test files. I ran each mutant independently and reverted each one; src is clean afterwards. M1 (useHeadingFocus without the enabled guard) fails e2e/home-first-load.spec.ts in both Chromium and WebKit with received {onBody:false,onHeading:true}. M2 (playerView(table.hand, 5)) fails tests/ui/user-seat-cards.acceptance.test.tsx with expected ['4c','Qd'] to equal ['Js','9s']. M3 (DEFAULT_SEATS.map) fails tests/table/session-stacks.acceptance.test.ts because the list has 6 entries instead of 5. All three pass on the current code. SPEC-02 takes its expected cards straight from engine HandState rather than through playerView, so it does not depend on the code under test. The regex extraction is sound for the current markup: there is no nested li or div inside the user seat or the 'Your cards' group. SPEC-03 uses the specified seats 1,3,5,7,9 with userSeat 5, button 9, the default stake and buy-in 160. Gates are green (57 lines, 3 files). No findings.
